title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
description: A psychological thriller about a woman's act of violence against her husband, and the therapist obsessed with uncovering her motive.

title: Where the Crawdads Sing
author: Delia Owens
description: A coming-of-age story wrapped in a murder mystery, set in the marshlands of North Carolina.

title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
description: A shepherd boy travels from Spain to Egypt in search of treasure, discovering the meaning of life along the way.

title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
description: A handbook of agile software craftsmanship that teaches principles and best practices of writing clean, maintainable code.

title: Eloquent JavaScript
author: Marijn Haverbeke
description: A modern introduction to programming, covering JavaScript fundamentals, the browser, and Node.js.

title: You Don't Know JS
author: Kyle Simpson
description: A deep dive into the core mechanisms of the JavaScript language, including scope, closures, and prototypes.

title: Design Patterns
author: Erich Gamma
description: A classic guide to reusable object-oriented software design patterns used across the software industry.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An exploration of cosmology, covering topics like the Big Bang, black holes, and the nature of time itself.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A journey through the universe exploring the origins of life, the cosmos, and humanity's place within it.

title: The Selfish Gene
author: Richard Dawkins
description: A groundbreaking work on evolutionary biology, explaining evolution from the perspective of the gene.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A brief history of humankind, exploring how Homo sapiens came to dominate the world.

title: Summary of Atomic Habits
author: John Cleverly
description: A practical guide on how tiny changes in behavior can lead to remarkable results in personal and professional life.
